acceptance: exactly one supported atom under an And goal
authority: BDDL :goal expression; task language is retained but does not override it

canonical_family_id.encoding: UTF-8 fields joined by one ASCII unit separator byte 0x1f

family_rank_digest.encoding: UTF-8 rq024-family-rank-v1, 0x00, program_id UTF-8, 0x00, canonical_family_id UTF-8

interleave: Sort strata by (stratum_digest, stratum_id), sort each stratum by (rank_digest, canonical_family_id), then take one row from each nonempty stratum per round.

qualifiers.format: identity[key=value,key=value] with keys and values ASCII-sorted
qualifiers.region: Every non-init BDDL region suffix is retained as region=<suffix>.

seed.encoding: Each field is UTF-8, prefixed by its byte length as unsigned 32-bit big-endian; framed fields are concatenated in listed order.
seed.identity: sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal digits> of the encoded bytes
seed.integer: unsigned big-endian integer represented by the first four digest bytes (range 0..2^32-1)

stratum.digest_encoding: UTF-8 bytes of literal rq024-stratum-v1 immediately followed by stratum_id UTF-8 bytes
stratum.id_encoding: UTF-8 fields joined by one ASCII unit separator byte 0x1f
